rules.rule: Exactly one change per proposal, applied only on explicit approval
must: Propose\ exactly\ one\ change
apply\ only\ on\ explicit\ approval
never\ edit\ without\ confirmation

rules.rule: Never invents a figure; placeholder in the after text
must: Never\ invent\ a\ figure\ neither\ the\ SRD\ nor\ the\ user\ gives
`\[TBD:\ lockout\ minutes\]`

rules.rule: Never edits metadata or Status, never proposes a Status transition
must: never\ edits\ metadata\ \(Owners,\ Initiative,\ Designs\),\ sets\ back\-links,\ or\ changes\ `Status`
never\ proposes\ a\ Status\ transition

rules.rule: Never writes <srd>.review.md; hands off to review check
must: It\ never\ writes\ `<srd>\.review\.md`
hands\ off\ to\ `review\ <srd>\ check`

rules.rule: Approved SRD ids frozen; any id change stated and approved in the loop
must: on\ an\ approved\ SRD\ ids\ are\ frozen
any\ id\ change\ is\ stated\ and\ approved\ in\ the\ loop's\ confirmation,\ never\ applied\ quietly

rules.rule: Y, S and E never advance the walk; only YN or explicit ask
must: Advance\ to\ the\ next\ entry\ only\ on\ `YN`\ or\ an\ explicit\ ask
Comment\ blocks\ are\ read\-only

rules.rule: Never proposes pushing, publishing, syncing, or accepting
must: never\ proposes\ pushing,\ publishing,\ or\ syncing\ the\ SRD\ as\ a\ follow\-up
Acceptance\ is\ a\ human\ decision

rules.rule: Every applied edit logged in <srd>.decisions.md before the next proposal
must: Log\ the\ change\ in\ `<srd>\.decisions\.md`\ before\ proposing\ the\ next\ one

rules.rule: #n with no review file says so and stops
must: if\ absent,\ say\ so\ and\ stop
those\ report\ a\ run\ that\ happened,\ and\ this\ one\ did\ not

rules.rule: Draft scaffolds never removed silently; In Scope derivation never self-triggered
must: never\ remove\ either\ silently
Never\ trigger\ the\ In\ Scope\ derivation\ on\ your\ own

rules.rule: Run the project gate first, before any other work
must: Run\ the\ project\ gate\ first

rules.rule: A cut requirement files one confirmed wrong gap per KB section it introduced for this SRD; the KB section is never edited
must: A\ removal\ \(deletion,\ or\ the\ STA\-8\ strike\)\ in\ any\ mode\ that\ reaches\ it\ gets\ a\ lookup\ too
as\ a\ confirmed\ `wrong`\ gap
every\ other\ SRD\ the\ attestation\ line\ names
Never\ edit\ the\ KB\ section

rules.rule: A KB section contradicting a change is a finding named in the proposal, never aligned by rank
must: Never\ align\ the\ SRD\ to\ the\ KB,\ or\ the\ KB\ to\ the\ SRD,\ by\ `rank`:\ an\ SRD\ has\ none

rules.rule: No hard-coded trust order or folder name
